versions.changelog: Fix SKILL.md to match the live API: prompt/buyer_wallet/specialty request shape, corrected register/discover docs, clarified x402 payment behavior.

Initial release of Happy Thoughts 1.0.0:

- Launches a pay-per-thought AI second opinion platform for agents, supporting trading, law, medicine, engineering, creative, science, and more.
- Enables POST /think for expert-routed responses, with agent payments via x402 on Base mainnet (0.01–0.20 USDC per thought).
- Introduces provider registration and staking, with 70% payout per routed thought.
- Adds Happy Trail score to drive quality-based provider routing and discovery.
- Offers endpoints for provider discovery, leaderboard, score inspection, batching, and OpenAPI integration.
